title: Targeting allergic inflammation
prompt: A 22-year-old woman has allergic asthma that remains poorly controlled despite appropriate inhaled therapy. A specialist adds omalizumab after confirming eligibility. Which molecular interaction is most directly inhibited by this biologic?
options: IL-5 binding to its receptor
Acetylcholine binding to muscarinic receptors
Leukotriene binding to the CysLT1 receptor
Cortisol binding to intracellular glucocorticoid receptors
Binding of free IgE to its high-affinity receptor
answer: Binding of free IgE to its high-affinity receptor
explanation: Omalizumab binds free IgE, reducing its availability for receptor binding.

distractorExplanations.Binding of free IgE to its high-affinity: Omalizumab binds free IgE, reducing its availability for receptor binding.
distractorExplanations.IL-5 binding to its receptor: This is the pathway targeted by mepolizumab and reslizumab.
distractorExplanations.Acetylcholine binding to muscarinic rece: This is the mechanism of antimuscarinic bronchodilators.
distractorExplanations.Cortisol binding to intracellular glucoc: Omalizumab does not block glucocorticoid receptors.

title: Acute symptoms during maintenance therapy
prompt: A 31-year-old man receiving omalizumab for allergic asthma develops sudden wheezing and dyspnea after a viral respiratory infection. He asks whether an extra omalizumab injection will rapidly relieve the episode. Which explanation is most appropriate?
options: An extra dose replaces the need to assess attack severity
Maintenance treatment rules out a severe exacerbation
The episode proves the patient has no allergic component to asthma
Omalizumab is maintenance therapy and does not provide rapid rescue bronchodilation
Omalizumab directly relaxes bronchial smooth muscle within minutes
answer: Omalizumab is maintenance therapy and does not provide rapid rescue bronchodilation
explanation: The acute episode requires an appropriate reliever and severity assessment; an extra biologic dose is not rescue treatment.

distractorExplanations.Omalizumab is maintenance therapy and do: The acute episode requires an appropriate reliever and severity assessment; an extra biologic dose is not rescue treatment.
distractorExplanations.Omalizumab directly relaxes bronchial sm: It modifies IgE-mediated inflammation rather than acting as a rapid bronchodilator.
distractorExplanations.An extra dose replaces the need to asses: Clinical severity still determines urgent treatment.
distractorExplanations.Maintenance treatment rules out a severe: Exacerbations can occur despite biologic therapy.
distractorExplanations.The episode proves the patient has no al: Breakthrough symptoms do not exclude allergic disease.

title: A reaction after repeated dosing
prompt: A 40-year-old woman develops generalized urticaria, throat tightness and hypotension shortly after an omalizumab injection. She previously tolerated several injections, and she has no new food exposure or other medication use that day. Which interpretation best fits this presentation?
options: The findings are expected therapeutic effects
The reaction can be excluded if wheezing is absent
Anaphylaxis remains possible despite prior tolerated doses
Prior tolerance excludes a reaction to omalizumab
Isolated injection-site irritation explains the hypotension
answer: Anaphylaxis remains possible despite prior tolerated doses
explanation: Previous tolerance does not exclude a later severe allergic reaction.

distractorExplanations.Anaphylaxis remains possible despite pri: Previous tolerance does not exclude a later severe allergic reaction.
distractorExplanations.Prior tolerance excludes a reaction to o: Reactions can occur after more than one dose.
distractorExplanations.Isolated injection-site irritation expla: Local irritation does not explain airway and circulatory involvement.
distractorExplanations.The findings are expected therapeutic ef: Airway symptoms and hypotension are not desired effects.
distractorExplanations.The reaction can be excluded if wheezing: Anaphylaxis need not include every possible respiratory sign.

title: Choosing dosing inputs
prompt: A specialist is initiating omalizumab for a patient who meets criteria for allergic asthma. Two otherwise similar eligible patients differ in pretreatment total IgE and body weight. Which information is used to select their asthma dosing-table regimen?
options: Identical fixed dosing for every asthma patient
Pretreatment total IgE together with body weight
Body temperature and serum sodium
A total IgE level measured after treatment alone
The latest eosinophil count alone
answer: Pretreatment total IgE together with body weight
explanation: The asthma dosing tables use these two inputs; dosing rules differ by indication.

distractorExplanations.Pretreatment total IgE together with bod: The asthma dosing tables use these two inputs; dosing rules differ by indication.
distractorExplanations.Body temperature and serum sodium: These are not the asthma dosing-table inputs.
distractorExplanations.A total IgE level measured after treatme: Treatment alters measured total IgE, making it unsuitable as the sole starting-table input.
distractorExplanations.The latest eosinophil count alone: Eosinophils may characterize disease but do not replace the omalizumab asthma dosing inputs.
distractorExplanations.Identical fixed dosing for every asthma: Asthma dosing is selected using the relevant dosing table.

title: Food-allergy counseling
prompt: A child receiving omalizumab to reduce reactions from accidental food exposure has fewer reactions. The family asks whether the child may now intentionally eat the trigger food and discard prescribed emergency medication. Which counseling point is correct?
options: Continue allergen avoidance and retain the emergency treatment plan
Intentional exposure is safe after the first tolerated injection
Omalizumab replaces emergency treatment during anaphylaxis
Avoidance is unnecessary whenever symptoms improve
Protection can be guaranteed by increasing the next dose after exposure
answer: Continue allergen avoidance and retain the emergency treatment plan
explanation: Omalizumab reduces risk from accidental exposure; it does not make intentional exposure safe or treat acute anaphylaxis.

title: Eosinophil signaling

options: Interleukin-4 receptor alpha
Immunoglobulin E
Tumor necrosis factor alpha
Thymic stromal lymphopoietin
Interleukin-5

title: Different administration routes

Both by nebulization
Mepolizumab intramuscularly; reslizumab orally

Mepolizumab intravenously; reslizumab subcutaneously

title: An infusion complication
prompt: During a reslizumab infusion, a 55-year-old man develops flushing, wheezing, throat tightness and hypotension. The infusion had been started for maintenance treatment of eosinophilic asthma. Which action is most appropriate regarding the infusion?
options: Treat this as an isolated local infusion-site reaction
Wait for a later eosinophil count before acting
Stop the infusion and initiate emergency management for anaphylaxis
Continue at the same rate because wheezing is part of asthma
Increase the infusion rate to complete treatment sooner
answer: Stop the infusion and initiate emergency management for anaphylaxis
explanation: The multisystem reaction requires prompt treatment, not continued exposure.

distractorExplanations.Increase the infusion rate to complete t: This increases exposure during a suspected serious reaction.

title: Corticosteroid adjustment
prompt: A 46-year-old woman with severe eosinophilic asthma improves after starting mepolizumab. She has taken systemic corticosteroids for months and wants to stop them immediately. Which plan best addresses medication withdrawal?
options: Double the biologic dose to prevent steroid withdrawal
Reduce corticosteroids gradually under clinician supervision when appropriate
Stop all corticosteroids on the day of the next injection
Replace the corticosteroid with extra mepolizumab as needed
Assume normal adrenal function because asthma symptoms improved
answer: Reduce corticosteroids gradually under clinician supervision when appropriate
explanation: Biologic improvement does not remove the risks of abrupt corticosteroid withdrawal.

title: A parasite before treatment
prompt: A 38-year-old man is being evaluated for mepolizumab because of severe eosinophilic asthma. His workup also identifies an active helminth infection. What is the most appropriate approach to this infection before starting the biologic?
options: Treat the existing helminth infection before initiating mepolizumab
Start mepolizumab to eradicate the helminth directly
Ignore the infection because eosinophils are always harmful
Treat only after a first biologic dose causes symptoms
Use omalizumab as an antiparasitic substitute

explanation: Eosinophils participate in host responses to some parasites; the label advises treating pre-existing helminth infection.
